help.title: Help & Support
help.customerFaq1Q: How do I book a worker?
help.customerFaq1A: Go to Home, pick a category or search, choose a worker, then pick a date & time and confirm your booking.
help.customerFaq2A: Each worker sets their own price range, shown on their profile. The final amount is confirmed before you pay.
help.customerFaq3Q: What if I need to cancel?
help.customerFaq3A: Open the booking from Bookings > Upcoming and tap Cancel. Cancellations under 1 hour before the slot may incur a partial charge.
help.customerFaq4A: Refunds for cancelled or disputed bookings are processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
help.customerFaq5A: Every worker on SahkarSeva is verified through their cooperative society before they can accept bookings.
help.workerFaq1A: Complete Registration under your profile — personal details, cooperative & skills, then upload your ID and skill certificates. Your cooperative reviews submissions within 1-2 business days.
help.workerFaq2A: Check the reason shown on your Verification Status screen — usually an unreadable photo or missing document — then re-submit from the same screen.
help.workerFaq3Q: How do I start receiving jobs?
help.workerFaq3A: Once verified, toggle yourself Online from the Home tab and keep your availability up to date under Manage Availability.
help.workerFaq4A: Payouts follow the schedule you choose under Earnings > Payout & bank details — daily, weekly, or monthly.
help.workerFaq5Q: How does the cooperative fee work?
help.workerFaq5A: Your cooperative retains a small percentage of each completed job (shown on your Earnings screen) — the rest is yours.
